proposal.hypothesis: In the O(N²) pair loop, factoring out the target mass removes repeated target-mass arithmetic, while explicit rsqrtf-based inverse-distance cubing replaces sqrtf, denominator multiplication, and per-pair division. This may reduce instruction cost without shared-memory tiling or target coarsening; the approximate reciprocal square root and altered accumulation require correctness and tolerance validation.

retained: Cache the output particle in a local variable and use its coordinates throughout the pair loop.
Accumulate acceleration with source mass after algebraically cancelling the target mass from force divided by target mass.
Use rsqrtf(distSq) and explicit multiplication to form inverse distance cubed, avoiding sqrtf and per-pair division.
Apply a target-mass identity factor once after the acceleration reduction to retain non-finite behavior for zero or non-finite target masses.

proposal.hypothesis: Mapping loop indices k=0..n-2 to j=k+(k>=i) skips the target without a per-pair equality/continue branch. It preserves the order and arithmetic of every non-self interaction, while eliminating one loop iteration per output; whether this offsets the extra index calculation is for the controller to measure.

retained: Replace the n-iteration loop and self-equality continue with n-1 iterations indexed by k; map each k around i using j=k+(k>=i). This visits the same non-self j values in the same order without changing interaction arithmetic.

model_reported.summary: Recorded the baseline and prior correctness failures as context; no candidate performance result is claimed, and the controller must measure the geometric-mean objective.

proposal.hypothesis: The current pair loop calculates j = k + (k >= i) for every interaction. Iterating directly over the two source ranges on either side of i should remove that per-pair comparison and index correction while visiting particles in the same order and leaving the floating-point arithmetic unchanged. The split loops may add divergence or code-size cost, so the controller must measure the official geometric-mean objective.

retained: Replace the fixed k loop and per-interaction conditional source-index adjustment with two direct ranges, j < i and j > i.
Preserve the original ascending source visit order and per-pair floating-point expressions.
